title: Sign out
purpose: Confirm that you want to end the current session.

items.label: Sign Out
items.description: POSTs the confirmation and ends this browser session, including any pending authentication stage, then returns to sign-in. Viewing this page with GET does not sign out. The account menu’s Sign out submits the same action directly without opening confirmation.

sections.title: Navigation and persistence
paragraphs: There is no Back or Cancel button in the confirmation form. Leave using normal page/navigation links if you want to stay signed in. Existing browser theme, column and documentation preferences are not removed by signing out. This is the account confirmation page; the administration Log out control is a separate immediate POST action.
